ModuleName: Batch Actions: Generating Content Across Multiple Modules at Once

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Lists the module's five topic areas — including what batch actions are, selecting content types, configuring modules, monitoring progress, and stopping a run — giving learners and instructors a structured overview of the module's scope.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Batch Actions in Course Manager
Artifacts.Description: Explains what batch actions are, why they save time when populating multiple modules with generated content, and how to access the feature in Course Manager, serving as the learner's conceptual introduction before they attempt any batch tasks.

Artifacts.Name: Selecting Content Types for Batch Generation
Artifacts.Description: Covers the distinct content types available for batch generation (such as topics and outcomes), how to choose the appropriate type for a run, and why only one content type can be generated per batch, helping learners make informed selections before starting.

Artifacts.Name: Choosing and Configuring Modules for a Batch Run
Artifacts.Description: Walks through the full setup process for a batch run — accessing the batch feature in Course Manager, selecting which modules to include, and configuring generation settings — so learners can correctly prepare and launch a multi-module content generation run.

Artifacts.Name: Monitoring Live Batch Progress
Artifacts.Description: Describes the live progress panel displayed during a batch run, explaining how to read individual module status indicators and the overall completion counter, so learners can actively monitor and interpret what is happening while generation is in progress.

Artifacts.Name: Stopping a Batch Run Safely
Artifacts.Description: Explains the circumstances that might require stopping a batch run early, the correct procedure for halting the process safely, and what happens to modules already processed, enabling learners to intervene without causing unintended data issues.
